archetype: High-Contrast Tactical Observability (Obsidian Command & Live Kinetic Telemetry)

theme_strategy.philosophy: Dark Obsidian command center with high-density kinetic visual feedback, crystal glass overlays, 1px tactical borders, and vivid status-mapped kinetic signals for real-time meta-agent execution.

font_families.mono: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h1: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white

banned_rules: Never use generic Inter for large display headers without tracking-tight
Never exceed text-5xl for dashboard headlines
Keep high contrast for monospaced telemetry logs

layout_and_grids.shell: h-screen flex flex-col bg-[#07090e] text-slate-100 overflow-hidden
layout_and_grids.header: h-14 border-b border-slate-800/80 px-5 flex items-center justify-between bg-[#0a0f18]/90 backdrop-blur-xl z-50 shrink-0
layout_and_grids.sidebar_runs: w-72 lg:w-80 border-r border-slate-800/80 bg-[#080d16] flex flex-col shrink-0 overflow-y-auto

core_sections.title: Run Orchestration Trigger (Target App, Credentials, PRD & Goals)
core_sections.description: Streamlined interactive launcher for initiating end-to-end autonomous runs with preset templates (e-commerce, SaaS auth, fintech dashboard, AI chatbot).

core_sections.title: Interactive State Machine DAG Visualizer
core_sections.description: Visual linear DAG (EXPLORE → PLAN → EVALUATE → GENERATE → RUN → HEAL → REPORT) showing live active pulse, node status, timing duration, loopback arcs for healer iterations, and clickable node drill-down.

core_sections.title: Live Meta-Agent Decision Log & Event Stream
core_sections.description: High-density streaming terminal console displaying explainable decision trails from Planner, Evaluator, Generator, and Healer with severity filters, sub-agent badges, raw JSON payload inspect, and live pause/resume/step controls.

core_sections.title: Test Plan & User Flow Hierarchy
core_sections.description: Structured hierarchical view of discovered flows tagged by flow type (Happy Path, Edge Case, Auth Boundary, Negative/Error Injection), priority level, selector targets, and PRD requirement link.

core_sections.title: Plan Evaluator Audit & Gap Analysis
core_sections.description: Coverage gaps identified before code generation, risk rating, missing boundary conditions, unexercised authentication branches, and auto-generated gap remediation prompts.

core_sections.title: Playwright Code Viewer & Selector Validator
core_sections.description: High-fidelity code view with syntax highlighting, live selector validation status (verified green vs fallback vs flaky), export specs button, and copy-ready runnable Playwright scripts.

core_sections.title: Live Test Runner & Step Telemetry
core_sections.description: Step-by-step browser action feed with simulated DOM view / action screenshot preview, step duration, assertion checkpoints, and live network request logs.

core_sections.title: Self-Healing vs Defect Decision Engine
core_sections.description: Side-by-side selector & DOM mutation diff, decision breakdown (Healed Script vs Genuine App Defect), confidence score meter (e.g. 94% Defect vs 88% Selector Drift), and explanation rationale.

core_sections.title: Comprehensive Test Quality & Risk Report
core_sections.description: Executive summary with Pass Rate %, Healed %, Untested Flow Risk Index, Defect Severity Matrix, PRD-to-Test Traceability Heatmap, and one-click Export as HTML/JSON/Markdown.

core_sections.title: Execution History & Comparative Analytics
core_sections.description: List of previous runs with URL tag, status pill, duration, pass/fail ratio, and quick comparison mode between successive builds.

motion_and_interactions.dag_pulse: CSS pulse animation and traveling neon light-beam along SVG connection wires
motion_and_interactions.event_stream: Smooth entrance transitions for new streaming logs with instant auto-scroll toggle
motion_and_interactions.monaco_tabs: Instant tab-switching with crisp indicator underlines
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Subtle border lighting on cards with hover:border-slate-700 transition-colors duration-200
motion_and_interactions.tooltips: Fast Radix tooltips with dark obsidian backdrop and 1px slate-800 border

accessibility_and_testing.wcag_compliance: High-contrast APCA readable text over dark backgrounds (white/slate-100 on dark slate)

image_urls.description: Telemetry background and developer code ambiance for empty states or hero headers
High-tech matrix streams for agent thinking / scanning visuals

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete autonomous test orchestration application in React (.js files) with Tailwind CSS and Radix/Lucide components.
Implement the live state-machine pipeline (EXPLORE → PLAN → EVALUATE → GENERATE → RUN → HEAL → REPORT) with rich realistic streaming simulation that allows testing any web URL or preset app.

Include pre-configured demo presets (e.g., 'E-Commerce Checkout Flow', 'SaaS Multi-Tenant Auth & Billing', 'Fintech Dashboard & Transfer', 'AI Assistant Chat Interface') so evaluators can trigger immediate realistic runs without typing.
Provide a full streaming decision console showing sub-agent thoughts, actions, tool calls, DOM selector inspections, and validation reasoning.
In the Monaco / Code view, provide complete realistic Playwright test specs (.spec.js) with page fixture, assertions, auto-waiting, and live selector status flags.

In the Self-Healer panel, visually showcase before/after DOM snippets, selector mutation diffs (e.g. data-testid='submit-btn' shifted to button[type='submit']), and confidence breakdown between Script Flake / Selector Drift (Healed) vs Actual Regression / Defect (Flagged with severity).
In the Final Report, provide rich metrics: Total flows, Passed, Failed defects, Self-healed, Untested Flow Risk Index, PRD Coverage Heatmap, and functional Export to JSON & HTML report download.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, tabs, and key status badges contain the required data-testid attributes.
Use Sonner for toasts upon actions (Triggering Run, Copying Code, Exporting Report, Retrying Flow).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered cards and gray flat boxes. Use high-density tactical grids, crisp 1px borders, subtle glows, and monospace telemetry badges.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not apply 'transition: all' globally. Use targeted transitions on background-color, border-color, and opacity.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_standards: All status indicators and text must meet APCA / WCAG AA readability against dark slate obsidian surfaces.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_usage: Use sonner for notifications located in /src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
